question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Feeling of being in a place before having already experienced the present situation
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Deja-vu"** refers to the feeling that one has lived through the present situation before. (पहले भी देखा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example:** As she walked into the old house, she experienced a strong sense of **deja-vu.**
 
 
 
• **"Deja-vu"** is a **French term** that literally means **"already seen"**. It is commonly used to describe a situation where a person feels that they have already experienced the present moment. (पहले से देखा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** He felt a strange sense of **deja-vu** when he met her for the first time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is **'Deja-vu.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Illusion** (भ्रम): A false idea or belief, or something that appears to be something that it is not.

 
 
• **Example:** The magician created the** illusion** of a disappearing rabbit.
 
 
 
• **Spirituality** (आध्यात्मिकता): The quality of being concerned with the human spirit or soul as opposed to material or physical things.
 
 
• **Example:** She found comfort in her **spirituality **during difficult times.
 
 
 
• **Delusion** (मोह): A belief or impression that is firmly maintained despite being contradicted by what is generally accepted as reality or rational argument.
 
 
• **Example:** His belief that he could fly was a dangerous **delusion.**
